answers.drew: The idea of telling stories and giving your own perspective is what drew me to the entertainment industry. Also allowing yourself to be exposed to different work styles and being able to meet people from all around the world.
answers.seeking: I am looking to connect with people who have a wide array of experience in agencies and production companies.
answers.inspiration: My biggest inspiration is Mike Flanagan. He was one of the first filmmakers I saw that made me want to pursue filmmaking. His storytelling, especially with horror, inspired me.
